edit_rationale.objective: Full-period field and well oil and water rates. No additional terminal weighting; pressure and gas do not rank candidates.
edit_rationale.parent_case: round4_connectivity: retain all permeability and initial composition values and edit only porosity in the same I12-W to P16 connection region.
edit_rationale.observed_feedback: For P16 in round four the water-rate RMSE through day 1789 was 180.85 m3/day. The last rate was 240.12 against 461.68 observed; at day 1439 it was 12.91 against 158.39. At day 1281 the rate was 1.46 against 4.97. The earlier excess water has diminished; do not reinstate the uniform bottom-water Kh enhancement.
edit_rationale.spatial_evidence: diagnostics_round4_1789: Sw along the 11-node static path is approximately [.481,.647,.809,.492,.461,.413,.381,.331,.308,.334,.294]. The water front has advanced toward the producer. A static path is not a tracer streamline and cannot uniquely identify the source of water.
edit_rationale.physical_hypothesis: Reduce hydrocarbon-bearing pore volume along the existing path with permeability held fixed. Test whether the front arrives earlier and the day 1300 to 1800 water-rate match improves. Nonlinear field-wide responses may affect pressure and other wells. Use a complete forward run to measure the effect; the porosity multiplier alone gives no fitted score.
edit_rationale.porosity_eligibility_conditions: Only active cells with initial Sw < .99 and parent-cell pore volume > 1e-3 m3 are eligible. Pure-water regions and inactive cells retain their values. Written porosity satisfies 0 < phi < 1.
edit_rationale.fixed_conditions: Retain all permeabilities, initial composition, initial pressure/Sw/temperature, EOS, SCAL, grid, completions, historical well controls, numerical settings and simulator source. The five component fractions remain nonnegative and sum to one in each cell.
edit_rationale.verification_requirements: Run from t0 for 516 reports over 2891 days. Compare rounds three and four and the formal baseline under the fixed full-period metric. Each run keeps the same fields throughout.

parallel_execution_note: Propose candidates using already simulated windows. The baseline and ranked candidates must each complete 2891 days under the same scoring rules.
